description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, a log filtering component that passes only log messages, stripping metadata. It implements the LogNode interface and manages a chain of log nodes.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that outputs only messages, ignoring metadata and other log details.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters log entries to output only the message part to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
